{{Top|leg}}
The '''Royal Space Marines''' were a special operations force in the [[Hapan Royal Navy]] of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]. These military officers were all [[Gender/Legends|female]] and continued serving the royalty in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[Swarm War]]. This mobile group was attached to the [[Hapan Royal Navy]] could undertake ground based operations as well as [[Realspace/Legends|space]] combat.
